discourse.title: Where There Is Purity, There Is Divinity
discourse.excerpt: When you respect and love an individual, he will respect you and love you in turn. But when you respect and love everyone, God Himself will respect you and love you. You should make efforts to become recipients of God's love.
discourse.theme: Where there is purity, there is divinity — love everyone, and God loves you.

reflection: Do you want to be loved by God? Swami gives you the shortest path: love everyone. He promises that when you respect and love one person, they return it — but when you love all, God Himself loves you back. Start with one difficult person today; that is where purity is tested and divinity is found.

bhajan.title: Prem Ishwar Hai, Ishwar Prem Hai

seva_nudge: Forgive one small slight today — a curt word, a forgotten call — and answer it with warmth.
